summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by John Deere Capital Corporation (JDCC) disclosing its quarterly results of operations for Q2 fiscal 2026. The filing reports revenue of $1.167 billion (down 2% YoY) and net income of $151 million (up 22% YoY). Additionally, it incorporates by reference Deere & Company's press release and earnings presentation. There are no special-situation elements: no merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. The filing is purely a standard quarterly earnings update.
